cases.scope: Build and explicitly deliver the complete lightweight source BIM and viewer from all supplied drawings, covering every floor. Read and calibrate the whole set, draft each plan, and perform local actual-result overlay comparisons during reading. Save independent elevation readings with their adopted-value overlays and local judgments. Assemble checked plans, resolve cross-drawing conflicts and apply supported opening heights. Review the complete building for architectural plausibility, reuse unchanged local comparisons, and revise only identified problems. Preserve physical rooms, partitions, all openings, hosts and connectivity, with one shared origin and the current 0.1 m regularization policy. Keep observations, assumptions and unresolved evidence distinct; process completion is not independent quality certification. Work in this single context and finish with finish_bim. There is no run-level time deadline.
